definitionZh: : past CSS 伪类选择器是一个时间维的伪类,它将匹配完全出现在匹配: current 的元素前的任何元素. 例如,在WebVTT显示的带字幕的视频中。
sourceDefinition: The :past CSS pseudo-class selector is a time-dimensional pseudo-class that will match for any element which appears entirely before an element that matches :current. For example in a video with captions which are being displayed by WebVTT.
